controller_of_examinations.name: Prof. Pankaj Jaiswal
controller_of_examinations.office: Examination Cell, Main Building, SBJITMR Campus

examination_structure.system: Semester Pattern with Choice Based Credit System (CBCS)
components: Continuous Assessment Tests (CAT): Internal continuous evaluation including CAT-I, CAT-II, quizzes, assignments, and mini-projects.
End Semester Examination (ESE): Comprehensive theory and practical examinations conducted at the end of each semester by the Autonomous Examination Cell.
examination_structure.grading_system: 10-Point Grading Scale (O, A+, A, B+, B, C, P, F) resulting in Semester Grade Point Average (SGPA) and Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA).

cgpa_to_percentage_conversion.alternative_direct_multiplier: As per RTMNU and autonomous ordinances: Percentage = CGPA * 10 (or as specified in the official Autonomous Grade Card / Examination Manual)

revaluation_and_open_day.open_day_policy: SBJITMR conducts an 'Open Day' after valuation where students can physically inspect their evaluated answer scripts in the presence of faculty evaluators to address any valuation discrepancies.
revaluation_and_open_day.revaluation_process: Students not satisfied with evaluated scores can apply for formal revaluation/re-checking through the Exam Cell within the stipulated date following result announcement.

supplementary_and_backlog_exams.procedure: Supplementary / makeup examinations are conducted for students having backlogs in odd or even semesters to help them clear pending subjects without losing an academic year.

online_results_portal.instructions: Enter your USN and date of birth to view your result/SGPA/CGPA.

online_examination_form_submission.procedure: Exam forms are submitted online: go to the college website, Exam Cell, then Exam Form Registration. For first login, use your USN/PRN as both Login ID and Password, then change the password and log in again. Regular students use Exam Registration to check registered courses; backlog students use Backlog Course Registration to select courses. Check the applicable examination fees, accept the agreement, and pay via UPI/scanner, cards or net banking. After successful payment, download/print the examination form and fee receipt, sign both, and submit them to the respective department. Backlog students must submit a separate examination form for each semester. Forms and fees must be submitted by the notified dates; late and super-late fees apply after the normal deadline, and forms are not accepted after the super-late-fee deadline.
